about: Fortnite's three harvesting materials. They go straight into their own inventory slot (after the ammo slots) when you break a tree or a house wall/roof, and show on the HUD. maxCarry: the most you can hold (creator: 99, one slot, never a second stack; harvesting at the cap gives no more). Build mode (G) spends them: block / stairs are what a built piece is made of; pieceHealth is how much gun damage a built piece takes before it breaks.
